_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4361 — the one label fold point `CommandResolver.readAssetLabel`, shared by resolveLabelByUID (#4007) and the ancestor walk's seed label (#4354). M1 is #4354's former M6 and M2 its former M5, moved here with the code they guard (the seed-label fold moved into this helper). `red_re` anchors on the `● <suite> › [Xn]` failure header, not on a bare key: jest echoes neighbouring `it(...)` source lines in its diff context (integration-test-revert-verify §A44/§A104).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/CommandResolver.ts

M1_literal_folded_by_string_shape._note: The pre-#4361 behaviour: a Literal label that looks like a URL is folded (`https://example.com/page.md` → `page`). resolveLabelByUID returns a label the asset never had (R1) and the ancestor walk excludes the genuine superclass file `page.md` (A6).
M1_literal_folded_by_string_shape.to: if (node instanceof Literal) return /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(node.value) ? (iriToObsidianName(node.value) ?? node.value) : node.value;

M2_term_iri_not_folded._note: No fold at all: a prefix__Local label comes back as its term IRI (#4007 regression, R2) and the walk's seed never enters `excluded` in symbolic form, so a cyclic chain lists the seed as its own ancestor (A5).
M2_term_iri_not_folded.from: if (node instanceof IRI) return iriToObsidianName(node.value) ?? node.value;

M3_literal_label_dropped._note: A Literal label is lost: resolveLabelByUID returns null for every human label (R3) and for the URL-looking one (R1), and the walk no longer excludes a seed whose label is a Literal — a cycle through a label-less class (basename label, emitted as a Literal) lists the seed as its own ancestor (A7).
